title: Genomic and Immunophenotypic Landscape of Acquired Resistance to PD-(L)1 Blockade in Non-Small-Cell Lung Cancer.
authors: Ricciuti, Biagio; Lamberti, Giuseppe; Puchala, Sreekar R; Mahadevan, Navin R; Lin, Jia-Ren; Alessi, Joao V; Chowdhury, Alexander; Li, Yvonne Y; Wang, Xinan; Spurr, Liam; Pecci, Federica; Di Federico, Alessandro; Venkatraman, Deepti; Barrichello, Adriana P; Gandhi, Malini; Vaz, Victor R; Pangilinan, Andy J; Haradon, Danielle; Lee, Elinton; Gupta, Hersh; Pfaff, Kathleen L; Welsh, Emma L; Nishino, Mizuki; Cherniack, Andrew D; Johnson, Bruce E; Weirather, Jason L; Dryg, Ian D; Rodig, Scott J; Sholl, Lynette M; Sorger, Peter; Santagata, Sandro; Umeton, Renato; Awad, Mark M
journal: Journal of clinical oncology : official journal of the American Society of Clinical Oncology
one_liner_zh: 该文研究非小细胞肺癌对PD-(L)1阻断的获得性耐药的基因组和免疫表型特征，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作、转录因子结合或AI/物理模拟建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: PURPOSE: Although immune checkpoint inhibitors (ICI) have extended survival in patients with non-small-cell lung cancer (NSCLC), acquired resistance (AR) to ICI frequently develops after an initial benefit. However, the mechanisms of AR to ICI in NSCLC are largely unknown. METHODS: Comprehensive tumor genomic profiling, machine learning-based assessment of tumor-infiltrating lymphocytes, multiplexed immunofluorescence, and/or HLA-I immunohistochemistry (IHC) were performed on matched pre- and post-ICI tumor biopsies from patients with NSCLC treated with ICI at the Dana-Farber Cancer Institute who developed AR to ICI. Two additional cohorts of patients with intervening chemotherapy or targeted therapies between biopsies were included as controls. RESULTS: We performed comprehensive genomic profiling and immunophenotypic characterization on samples from 82 patients with NSCLC and matched pre- and post-ICI biopsies and compared findings with a control cohort of patients with non-ICI intervening therapies between biopsies (chemotherapy, N = 32; targeted therapies, N = 89; both, N = 17). Putative resistance mutations were identified in 27.8% of immunotherapy-treated cases and included acquired loss-of-function mutations in STK11, B2M, APC, MTOR, KEAP1, and JAK1/2; these acquired alterations were not observed in the control groups. Immunophenotyping of matched pre- and post-ICI samples demonstrated significant decreases in intratumoral lymphocytes, CD3e(+) and CD8a(+) T cells, and PD-L1-PD1 engagement, as well as increased distance between tumor cells and CD8(+)PD-1(+) T cells. There was a significant decrease in HLA class I expression in the immunotherapy cohort at the time of AR compared with the chemotherapy (P = .005) and the targeted therapy (P = .01) cohorts. CONCLUSION: These findings highlight the genomic and immunophenotypic heterogeneity of ICI resistance in NSCLC, which will need to be considered when developing novel therapeutic strategies aimed at overcoming resistance.
abstract_zh: 目的：尽管免疫检查点抑制剂（ICI）已延长非小细胞肺癌（NSCLC）患者的生存期，但在初始获益后，对ICI的获得性耐药（AR）频繁出现。然而，NSCLC中对ICI产生AR的机制在很大程度上尚不清楚。方法：对在丹娜-法伯癌症研究所接受ICI治疗并发生AR的NSCLC患者，在ICI治疗前和治疗后的匹配肿瘤活检样本中，进行了全面的肿瘤基因组分析、基于机器学习评估的肿瘤浸润淋巴细胞、多重免疫荧光和/或HLA-I免疫组织化学（IHC）检测。另外纳入两个对照组，其活检间隔期间接受了化疗或靶向治疗。结果：我们对82例NSCLC患者（具有匹配的ICI治疗前和治疗后活检样本）的样本进行了全面的基因组分析和免疫表型特征描述，并将结果与活检间隔期间接受非ICI干预治疗（化疗，N=32；靶向治疗，N=89；两者兼有，N=17）的对照组患者进行了比较。在27.8%的免疫治疗病例中鉴定出推定的耐药突变，包括STK11、B2M、APC、MTOR、KEAP1和JAK1/2的获得性功能缺失突变；这些获得性改变在对照组中未观察到。对匹配的ICI治疗前和治疗后样本进行的免疫表型分析显示，瘤内淋巴细胞、CD3e(+)和CD8a(+) T细胞以及PD-L1-PD1结合显著减少，同时肿瘤细胞与CD8(+)PD-1(+) T细胞之间的距离增加。在AR发生时，免疫治疗队列中HLA I类表达显著降低，与化疗队列（P = .005）和靶向治疗队列（P = .01）相比差异显著。结论：这些发现突显了NSCLC中ICI耐药的基因组和免疫表型异质性，在制定旨在克服耐药的新型治疗策略时需考虑这一点。
